Let the learner set the API server address and a personal access token in the app, keep the token in the iPhone's secure storage, and send it with every request. Without it the real API rejects the app, because it only accepts the shared secret or a personal access token.

Fix the offline question cache in three cases: do not reload the exercise after coming back from the discuss screen, do not show the offline banner when a request was only cancelled, and ignore a double tap on Next. Today these reload the exercise, wrongly say the app is offline, and can skip a question.
